name: Chrysaor
intro: Chrysaor is new, named after the golden-sword son of Medusa. It's gold and black like a Marshall, in the same family as Melinoe, Hyperion and the tarot amps: black lacquer with gold baroque scrollwork, and a winged sword in a laurel wreath under a crown. Below that is a brushed-gold control panel with the 2203's six knobs in their real order, the inputs on the right, and the power lamp on the left.
notes: This pack is a full grid: Gain 1 to 10, captured at three Master settings (5, 6 and 7). That's 30 captures, all with the EQ at 5.
Gain steps through the ten gain captures, and Master crossfades between the three master levels, so both knobs behave like the real amp. The power section pushes harder as Master goes up.
The 2203 has one channel, so there are no channel buttons.
Amp only, so it works with your cab section.
